instruction: Have Glitch jack into the data shard and read out the contacts stored on it.

target.reason: The page offers no verb for using an item or jacking into it — depart, say, say-to, whisper, offer, accept, and refuse cannot make Glitch read the contacts off the data shard. None of the available end states (holding the shard, being in a room, or saying something) captures 'read out the contacts stored on it', and even moving the shard from rogue to glitch would only change its holder, not produce the readout.
